capfood.subtitle: Select the foods you want to raise to steak level.
capfood.base.label: CAP BASE
capfood.base.name: STEAK
capfood.list.title: CONFIGURABLE FOODS
capfood.food.lore: Your favorite foods at the same level as Cooked Beef.
capfood.food.description: Applies the same nutritional values as Cooked Beef.
capfood.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
capfood.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
capfood.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
capfood.options.consume_container.lore: To the last drop — container included.
capfood.options.consume_container.descri: Also consumes stew bowls, honey bottles and drinkable potion bottles.
capfood.options.show_food_properties.lor: Nutritional information at the press of Shift.
capfood.options.show_food_properties.des: Shows hunger, saturation and consumption time while holding Shift over a compatible food or the reference Cooked Beef.
An asterisk reveals what is hidden.
Adds an asterisk to the end of the name of every item with information shown only while holding Shift, including content from Minecraft and other mods.
capfood.options.prevent_rotten_flesh_wol: Rotten Flesh is no treat for a wolf.
Prevents feeding wolves with Rotten Flesh.
capfood.options.prevent_primary_food_con: Essential ingredients stay off the menu.
Prevents consuming these 12 primary foods: Beetroot, Carrot, Potato, Raw Beef, Raw Chicken, Raw Mutton, Raw Porkchop, Raw Rabbit, Pufferfish, Raw Cod, Raw Salmon and Tropical Fish.
capfood.options.horse_ignores_leaves.lor: The ride continues freely through the foliage.
capfood.options.horse_ignores_leaves.des: Removes leaf collision for horse-family mounts while controlled by a player.
capfood.options.faster_leaf_decay.lore: The canopy keeps pace with the axe.
capfood.options.faster_leaf_decay.descri: After cutting the last connected log of a natural Overworld tree, assigned leaves disappear 20× faster than vanilla. Touching canopies estimate leaf origin by log proximity. Remaining leaves disappear together after 5 seconds.
capfood.options.increased_sapling_bee_ne: More flowers, more trees, more bees.

Increases from 5% to 20% the chance for oak, birch and cherry trees grown from saplings to generate with a bee nest containing 2–3 bees when a flower is within 2 blocks horizontally and 1 block vertically of the sapling.
capfood.status.applied: CAP applied to the selected foods.
